title: Rider / delivery portal — completion backlog

product_rules_agreed: Middo P&L must account for ALL costs against revenue (kitchen share, rider commissions, direct costs, etc.) — rest = profit/loss
Rider earns commission per ORDER or per RUN — never per Middo group
HYBRID commission sources (D1 decided): lunch/meal kitchen→corporate uses menu.delivery_commission; all other run types use admin Settings defaults (+ per-rider overrides)
Settings-backed run types (defaults): corporate→kitchen (box), kitchen→ops (box), ops→kitchen (box), plus future custom point X→Y
Do NOT stack menu.delivery_commission AND a settings lunch rate on the same order — one cost path per run
Admin sets commission per settings run type; rider overrides optional; rider sees commission details only when effective rate is set (> 0)
Commission credited to rider wallet on RUN START → Middo owes rider
Lunch delivery_share accrues once at run start from menu.delivery_commission — never a second time on delivered_and_paid
Box/custom rider commissions book into a Middo cost ledger (outside order middo_rest) so profit still reflects all rider cost
RIDER CASH UX (D5): after cash collect show Collection − Commission = Due to Middo; handover only the due amount (rider keeps commission from the cash bag)
Handover targets: kitchen or Middo/ops; accepting clears Due by that amount (kitchen ledger debit if kitchen; MiddoCashLedger if Middo/ops)
When cash covers commission, settle commission in-kind from the float — do NOT also leave that commission withdrawable
If no cash (or net Middo owes rider): show Wallet balance with Request payment / withdrawal
Rider may have multiple areas; parcel calls / notifications scoped to those areas
Rider portal needs a mobile-app-like UI (thumbs-first shell, bottom nav) — cleaner navigation now; foundation for a later native rider app

scope_improvements.title: Hybrid commission sources (DECIDED)
scope_improvements.why: Menu-priced lunch delivery stays meal-economics; box/custom legs are ops costs with flat settings rates.
scope_improvements.recommendation: KEEP menu.delivery_commission for kitchen→corporate lunch only. Accrue once at RUN START into rider ledger + order money tree. Settings commissions for box legs and custom X→Y only. Never accrue menu delivery_share again on delivered_and_paid if already credited at start.

scope_improvements.title: Dedicated rider_account_ledger (do not overload users.balance)
scope_improvements.why: users.balance is already corporate wallet + rider cash float. Mixing signed Middo-owes/owes-Middo with corporate WalletLedger is conflict-prone.
scope_improvements.recommendation: Mirror KitchenAccountLedger: rider_account_ledger as SoT. Keep users.balance as denormalized cache OR stop using it for riders and read ledger only.

scope_improvements.title: Define run unit explicitly per type
scope_improvements.why: Product says per order OR per run, not per group. Lunch accept is already per Order — good. Box legs are per MiddoBox today.
scope_improvements.recommendation: Serialize: lunch kitchen→corporate = menu.delivery_commission × qty per Order at accept. Box legs = settings rate per box. Custom = per run. Never × group size.

scope_improvements.title: Box/custom run commissions are Middo cost (often no order revenue) — AGREED
scope_improvements.why: Box repositioning and custom X→Y usually have no customer bill. P&L still needs the cost.
scope_improvements.recommendation: Order-linked lunch → order money events at run start only. Box/custom → Middo cost ledger so Accounts Hub / profit still includes all rider cost. Never stuff box/custom into orders.delivery_share_amount.

scope_improvements.title: Mobile-app-like rider shell now; native app later
scope_improvements.why: Delivery Livewire pages are desktop-ish; riders need cleaner, navigable thumbs-first UX. A later native app will reuse the same IA.
scope_improvements.recommendation: Ship R5 shell (bottom nav + layout + optional PWA) mirroring kitchen mobile shell. Keep routes/Livewire; avoid desktop-only chrome. Document nav IA for future React Native / Flutter / Cap app.

scope_improvements.title: Rider withdrawal only when Middo owes (no cash net)
scope_improvements.why: With cash-minus-commission handover, COD riders are usually paid in-kind from the bag. Withdrawal is for prepaid / no-cash / shortfall cases.
scope_improvements.recommendation: Request payment when wallet (Middo owes) > 0. Handover UI when Due to Middo > 0. Targets: kitchen or Middo/ops.

scope_improvements.title: Cleaner cash UI: Collection − Commission = Due (DECIDED)
scope_improvements.why: Handing full collection then withdrawing commission is harder for riders to reason about.
scope_improvements.recommendation: Show Collection, Commission, Due to Middo. Handover amount defaults to Due only. Auto-settle commission from cash float so it is not also withdrawable.

scope_improvements.title: Area-scoped claims race
scope_improvements.why: Today any rider can accept any kitchen dispatch (first claim wins).
scope_improvements.recommendation: Filter lists + StaffAlerts by rider areas; still first-claim among eligible riders.

scope_improvements.title: Custom run type (point X → point Y)
scope_improvements.why: Ops will need ad-hoc moves beyond the four defaults.
scope_improvements.recommendation: After core types: run entity with from/to labels (or location refs), commission amount (default from settings.custom or manual), credit on start, area scoping.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: Double cost: menu delivery_share vs settings lunch rate
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: Hybrid decision: lunch uses menu.delivery_commission ONLY. Settings rates apply to non-lunch runs only. Still must move lunch accrual from delivered_and_paid → run start and credit rider ledger (today PartnerPayable never hits rider wallet).
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: At KitchenDispatches::acceptOrder: credit rider ledger with menu.delivery_commission×qty (or rider lunch override). On delivered_and_paid: skip creating a second delivery_share if already accrued at start (idempotent). Box/custom: settings path only — never read menu.delivery_commission.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: users.balance semantic collision
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: PaymentModal increments users.balance by full cash. Kitchen handover decrements it. Corporate WalletLedger also uses users.balance. No signed ledger; cannot represent Middo-owes commission and owes-Middo cash cleanly.
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: SI2 — rider_account_ledger; migrate cash float entries into ledger (cash_collected debit, handover credit).

conflicts_and_gaps.title: Handover amount is Due to Middo, not full collection
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: Old path handed full cash_collected and left commission on wallet. New UX: handover only (collection − commission); rider keeps commission cash.
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: On cash collect: record cash held + settle open commission in-kind up to cash. Due = remaining cash debt. Handover credits rider due and debits kitchen (or credits Middo cash if target is Middo/ops). Never MiddoCashLedger on kitchen accept.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: Accrual timing mismatch with kitchen
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: Kitchen share credits on dispatch. Delivery share today on delivered_and_paid. Product wants rider credit on RUN START (accept / start box leg).
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: AGREED: Lunch credit at accept from menu; skip second accrual on delivered_and_paid. Box/custom credit at run start from settings into Middo cost ledger + rider wallet.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: PartnerPayable delivery settlement ignores rider wallet
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: AccountsHub settlePayable debits Middo cash for delivery role but never credits rider balance. Parallel kitchen path uses KitchenAccountLedger.
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: AccountsHub blocks delivery settle and links to Rider money withdrawals. RiderMoneyService settles payables + debits rider ledger + Middo cash together.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: Cancel / fail after run start
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: If order cancelled after rider accepted, open kitchen payable is voided and kitchen ledger debited. Delivery PartnerPayable void does not touch rider balance (none today). After R2, must void/reverse rider commission credit.
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: On cancel/reassign: RiderLedger debit share_voided if commission was credited; mark commission row void.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: Prepaid / online orders: commission without cash
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: Rider may complete lunch run with zero cash_collected. Wallet stays +commission only. Correct. Ensure PaymentModal does not invent cash float for gateway residuals (already guarded).
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: Keep; document in rider Account UI.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: Single area_id vs multi-area
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: User has one area_id. Delivery lists ignore area. No parcel-call / StaffAlerts for delivery role.
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: R0: area_user pivot (or rider_areas); migrate area_id → pivot; filter KitchenDispatches / box runs; delivery StaffAlerts.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: Commission visibility rule ambiguity
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: Sees commission only if set for him — unclear if unset means hide (use default silently) or no pay.
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: Lunch: show when menu.delivery_commission (or rider lunch override) > 0. Other runs: effective = rider override ?? settings default; show when effective > 0. If 0, no credit and no commission UI line.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: Ops→kitchen assign may bundle many boxes
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: AssignMiddoBoxesModal can assign multiple boxes to one rider. Per-box vs per-assignment commission affects cost.
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: Default per box at assignment accept/start (SI3). Document if ops wants batch rate later.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: TYPE_CASH_TO_MIDDO unused; cash_to_kitchen used on kitchen accept
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: Order money tree historically expected cash_to_middo. Kitchen wallet change wrote cash_to_kitchen. Rider handover clear should add rider-side money events without resurrecting Middo cash credit.
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: Add rider money events (commission_credited, cash_held, cash_handed_to_kitchen) in order tree when order-linked.

conflicts_and_gaps.title: middo_rest formula still subtracts menu delivery_share
conflicts_and_gaps.detail: computeBreakdown caps kitchen+delivery against bill net. Lunch still uses menu.delivery_commission in order P&L. Box/custom commissions must NOT be stuffed into orders.delivery_share_amount or middo_rest will be wrong.
conflicts_and_gaps.resolution: Keep menu delivery_share on lunch orders only. Book box/custom rider cost outside order middo_rest (SI4).

open_product_decisions.question: Is lunch kitchen→corporate commission the settings default, or still menu.delivery_commission (per meal)?
open_product_decisions.answer: Keep menu.delivery_commission for lunch. Settings commissions for box legs + custom X→Y only. No stacking.

open_product_decisions.question: Box runs: always per box, or allow per-assignment batch rate?
If rider override is null, silently use menu/settings default — or must admin explicitly enable the rider?
open_product_decisions.answer: Silently use menu/settings default. Show commission UI only when effective rate > 0.

open_product_decisions.question: Rider withdrawal: bKash/cash from Middo like kitchen, or net against future cash collections only?
open_product_decisions.answer: Withdrawal/request payment when Middo owes (typically no/insufficient cash). COD usually pays commission in-kind via Collection − Commission = Due handover.

open_product_decisions.question: Hand over full cash then withdraw commission, or hand over only Due (collection − commission)?
open_product_decisions.answer: Hand over Due only; rider keeps commission from cash. UI: Collection − Commission = Due to Middo. Handover to kitchen or Middo.
